entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集主线：不是把智能体装进产品，而是用智能体构建产品本身——写代码、评审、分诊 issue、修错误堆栈，10-20 个智能体并行运行会把 CI-CD 慢环节复合放大

evidence.quote: So that means the percent of agent-written code actually gets committed.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: How much kind of garbage has the agent produced that you threw out the window again or didn't trust and that you read it and scrapped?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And the big part is getting your code bases agent ready.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So that's kind of the no-brainer slide that everybody should have already been doing, is thinking about how to get your code bases agent ready, is creating agents.md that are lightweight enough and give the agents a good kind of map of the code base, where to look at, mapping out that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Those are living documents that should evolve as the agent makes mistakes and works.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And that's where I see a lot of teams that have invested in the developer experience actually gain a lot because once they have good documentation and onboarding for a code base, that is read by the agent as well and that can help the agent as much.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Next up, when agents actually work on UI, and we all had this, that the agent gives you UI, and it says it looks perfect, and you open it, and it's all misaligned.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If your agent cannot use your application, your product directly to get this feedback loop of is it all working, then that's a really big investment that pays off every time you work on UI.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So you can just hit launch, move on to the next task, and then come back once the agent verified its work because it can access your application.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Once you are in the issue, because the agent will make mistakes and we need that feedback loop when it makes mistakes, we create a Chrome extension that allows you to fix duplicated issues as well.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So we have the agent doing the work and we have a feedback loop where humans can still fix it that we can bring back into the agent work up front.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And the agent actually goes in and finds out why this has happened.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So the agent already opened the PR, we could just merge it, and that's a really great automated way.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So all of this automated, the triage initially, mix of agents and deterministic systems, then the issue is filed, handed off to an agent in the PR, multi-agent system, and in the end we have fixes landing mostly automatically with some human oversight to still approve the PR.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: When we file an issue to add a new scenario, there's actually an agent picking up from a template and bootstrapping the scenario for you.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
